vows.description: Descend the seven floors of Torre Nosferatu, take each floor's key, and reach the ground-floor door — escaping on your own light, not another's wake.
vows.name: Escape Torre Nosferatu

beyond the threshold.description: Outside. Cold air, the tower wall at your back, and a dark that belongs to the world — not to him. The candle flame stands straight up now, no longer leaning, no longer watched.
beyond the threshold.name: Beyond the Threshold

fifth floor — beast warren.description: Doorways laced floor to lintel with webbing. The webbing is soft, not dusty; it flexes when the light touches it, and closes again where it is torn. Spiders hang in the strands like dark fruit.
fifth floor — beast warren.name: Fifth Floor — Beast Warren

fifth floor — connector 1.description: A passage whose walls are faintly warm to the touch. The perfume follows you in. The dark between the sconces is not quite empty; something in it keeps the same pace you do.
fifth floor — connector 1.name: Fifth Floor — Connector 1

fifth floor — connector 2.description: A landing of cold iron sconces and dust. The dust is undisturbed except for one line of footprints that stop in the middle of the floor and do not go on.
fifth floor — connector 2.name: Fifth Floor — Connector 2

fifth floor — connector 3.description: A corridor that doubles back. There is no sconce lit anywhere in it. The walls are closer than they were, or you are more tired than you thought.
fifth floor — connector 3.name: Fifth Floor — Connector 3

fifth floor — connector 4.description: A cramped turn with a shelf of paper gone soft with rot — ledgers, letters, a few loose pages. One has slid clear of the rest.
fifth floor — connector 4.name: Fifth Floor — Connector 4

fifth floor — connector 5.description: A short bridge over a shaft. The candlelight reaches a few feet down and stops. The draught rising out of the dark carries the perfume up with it.
fifth floor — connector 5.name: Fifth Floor — Connector 5

fifth floor — entry landing.description: The stair arrives behind a heavy velvet curtain. Beyond it: mirrors angled wrong, and a low red glow that is not your candle. The air is thick with perfume and old smoke.
fifth floor — entry landing.name: Fifth Floor — Entry Landing

fifth floor — grand stair.description: A stair hung with velvet. The cloth eats the sound of your steps so completely that you keep checking your feet are moving. At the head, an iron door.
fifth floor — grand stair.name: Fifth Floor — Grand Stair

fifth floor — key room.description: A low room of silk the colour of a bruise. A bed, a vanity, two cups of wine — one full, one already poured. The key lies on a silk pillow between them.
fifth floor — key room.name: Fifth Floor — Key Room

fifth floor — social hall.description: Leather chairs, lamplight, a gramophone turning out a thin waltz with no one winding it. A woman rises from a chair as if she had been waiting exactly this long. Her candle is unlit.
fifth floor — social hall.name: Fifth Floor — Social Hall

fifth floor — trap hall.description: A bed the size of a small room, hung in silk. The sheets are knotted into a pattern no body makes in sleep. The silk is dark in places that are not shadows, and it moves very slightly, as if breathing.
fifth floor — trap hall.name: Fifth Floor — Trap Hall

fifth floor — wax refill.description: A marble basin brimming with warm wax. A skin has begun to set on the surface, as though someone stepped out a moment ago. The surface still trembles.
fifth floor — wax refill.name: Fifth Floor — Wax Refill

first floor — antechamber.description: Dust, a dead lantern, and an ancestral portrait whose painted eyes track the flame. On the far wall, the exit: heavy, iron-bound, locked. Cold air seeps around it. Beyond it is outside.
first floor — antechamber.name: First Floor — Antechamber

first floor — beast warren.description: Every creature the tower holds is gathered here, thickest near the exit — a pale bulk, wolves, rats, spiders hanging in ropes, shapes without names. They do not attack. They stand in the way and watch the candles.
first floor — beast warren.name: First Floor — Beast Warren

first floor — connector 1.description: A passage whose walls are gouged deeper than the others. Some of the gouges are old; some are not. The sconces are cold.
first floor — connector 1.name: First Floor — Connector 1

first floor — connector 2.description: A landing of cold iron sconces and settled dust. A bundle of matches lies within reach, wrapped in waxed thread.
first floor — connector 2.name: First Floor — Connector 2

first floor — connector 3.description: A corridor that doubles back. No sconce is lit. The gouges here are in sets of five, as if something counted its way along the wall.
first floor — connector 3.name: First Floor — Connector 3

first floor — connector 4.description: A cramped turn, the ceiling too near. The stone is scored in long parallel lines. The air smells of rust and old smoke.
first floor — connector 4.name: First Floor — Connector 4

first floor — connector 5.description: An alcove with a scratched warning low on the stone — the same hand as the tally marks above. Beside it lies a torn page, still readable.
first floor — connector 5.name: First Floor — Connector 5

first floor — connector 6.description: A short bridge of stone over a shaft that drops into the dark below. The draught from the shaft is cold and clean — the first clean air since the top of the tower.
first floor — connector 6.name: First Floor — Connector 6

first floor — entry landing.description: The stair arrives at the bottom of the tower, into cold air and old violence. The walls are scored and gouged. The air tastes of iron.
first floor — entry landing.name: First Floor — Entry Landing

first floor — key room.description: Broken weapons lie everywhere — spears snapped at the haft, swords bent, shields staved in. Every point and edge is turned toward the door you came through. The key rests on the flat of a shattered blade at the centre.
first floor — key room.name: First Floor — Key Room

first floor — trap hall.description: The floor is a cracked ruin of flagstones, the cracks running in long faults from wall to wall. The faults are widest at the centre and narrow toward the east wall, where the stones still key into their neighbours.
first floor — trap hall.name: First Floor — Trap Hall

first floor — wax refill.description: Wax pooled and hardened over old burns. The burns are shaped like hands. The room is cold, and the wax is cold, and it does not soften under your fingers.
first floor — wax refill.name: First Floor — Wax Refill

fourth floor — beast warren.description: Cages stand open, and the wolves stand outside them — thin, grey, pacing the bars they no longer need. They do not look at you. They look at each other, and at the empty cages.
fourth floor — beast warren.name: Fourth Floor — Beast Warren

fourth floor — bone passage.description: A servants' passage behind the laboratory wall, its floor gritty with chalk and splintered glass. A row of specimen labels has been pasted over the plaster.
fourth floor — bone passage.name: Fourth Floor — Bone Passage

fourth floor — cold turn.description: The passage narrows and turns beside a cold flue. Something has been scrubbed from the wall, but the scrubbing left a shape.
fourth floor — cold turn.name: Fourth Floor — Cold Turn

fourth floor — connector 1.description: A passage under a smell of dust and old paper. The sconces are cold. Something has been dragged along one wall, leaving a clean stripe in the grime.
fourth floor — connector 1.name: Fourth Floor — Connector 1

fourth floor — connector 2.description: A landing with a scorched mark where a candle died. The mark is old, but the wax around it is fresh, as if someone set a new candle in the same place and thought better of it.
fourth floor — connector 2.name: Fourth Floor — Connector 2

fourth floor — connector 3.description: A corridor that doubles back. No sconce is lit. The air is dry and still, and your flame stands straight up, as if it is being watched.
fourth floor — connector 3.name: Fourth Floor — Connector 3

fourth floor — connector 4.description: A cramped turn, the ceiling too near. The stone is cold. A row of small marks is scratched at eye height, too regular to be damage.
fourth floor — connector 4.name: Fourth Floor — Connector 4

fourth floor — connector 5.description: An alcove with a scratched warning low on the stone. The letters are worn; only the shape of them remains, and the shape is a hand pressed flat.
fourth floor — connector 5.name: Fourth Floor — Connector 5

fourth floor — entry landing.description: The stair arrives among glass, cold metal, and the smell of formaldehyde. Vitrines line the landing, each holding something preserved: a hand, a bird with too many eyes, a face that is almost yours. Every case is labelled in a small, exact hand.
fourth floor — entry landing.name: Fourth Floor — Entry Landing

fourth floor — fallen landing.description: A landing under a fallen beam, the way ahead low and awkward. The beam is chalked with a date that has been crossed out twice.
fourth floor — fallen landing.name: Fourth Floor — Fallen Landing

fourth floor — grand stair.description: A stair of glass treads, each reflecting a room you have not reached — a hall of candles, a door of teeth, a face at a window. The reflections do not move when you do.
fourth floor — grand stair.name: Fourth Floor — Grand Stair

fourth floor — key room.description: A cabinet of jars, shelf after shelf, each holding a shape in cloudy fluid and a label in the same exact hand. The key sits in one jar among them, its iron gone soft and grey through the glass.
fourth floor — key room.name: Fourth Floor — Key Room

fourth floor — social hall.description: A laboratory. Vitrines of specimens, a chalkboard dense with failed experiments, each row crossed out and dated. A woman stands at the board with chalk in hand and finishes the line before she turns.
fourth floor — social hall.name: Fourth Floor — Social Hall

fourth floor — trap hall.description: A case of glass and acid, its seams weeping a thin line that hisses where it touches the floor. The cracks in the glass run in one direction. Where they stop, the acid has spent itself.
fourth floor — trap hall.name: Fourth Floor — Trap Hall

fourth floor — wax refill.description: Copper stills, cold now, and wax rendered drip by drip into a trough. The room smells of fat and hot metal. The wax in the trough has set unevenly, like something cooled while moving.
fourth floor — wax refill.name: Fourth Floor — Wax Refill

second floor — beast warren.description: It lies against the far wall in the dark, half-asleep: a soft pale mass the size of a cart, with a mouth that opens and closes like slow breathing. It has no eyes. It turns toward heat, and toward light.
second floor — beast warren.name: Second Floor — Beast Warren

second floor — connector 1.description: A passage where the dust is thinner. The sconces are cold. Small bare footprints cross the floor in slow circles and never leave the corridor.
second floor — connector 1.name: Second Floor — Connector 1

second floor — connector 2.description: A landing with a dead lantern someone left behind. Beside it, half under the base, a small bundle of matches, dry and still usable.
second floor — connector 2.name: Second Floor — Connector 2

second floor — connector 3.description: A corridor that doubles back. No sconce is lit. The dust lies in a soft even blanket, just beginning to be disturbed by your feet.
second floor — connector 3.name: Second Floor — Connector 3

second floor — connector 4.description: A cramped turn with a shelf of paper gone to mush. Whatever was written there is not readable now. One scrap has stayed dry near the back.
second floor — connector 4.name: Second Floor — Connector 4

second floor — connector 5.description: An alcove where a torn page lies where someone dropped it. The dust has gathered only at its edges, as if the page had been set down carefully.
second floor — connector 5.name: Second Floor — Connector 5

second floor — dust passage.description: A service passage behind the sleeping hall, its air thick and warm. Dust lies in the seams of the boards, undisturbed except for one long track.
second floor — dust passage.name: Second Floor — Dust Passage

second floor — entry landing.description: The stair arrives into dust deep enough to hush it. The dust lies in soft, undisturbed dunes. The silence is so complete that your own breathing sounds like an interruption.
second floor — entry landing.name: Second Floor — Entry Landing

second floor — grand stair.description: A slow stair, each step deeper in dust than the last, as if it is falling asleep going down. At the head, an iron door.
second floor — grand stair.name: Second Floor — Grand Stair

second floor — key room.description: A single coffin stands open on a stone bier, its lid leaned against the wall. The key lies in the dust inside it — shallow enough to see, deep enough that you would have to put your hand in.
second floor — key room.name: Second Floor — Key Room

second floor — quiet turn.description: The passage turns beside a sealed door. No sound comes through it, not even the tower's breathing.
second floor — quiet turn.name: Second Floor — Quiet Turn

second floor — social hall.description: Coffins stand open along the walls, cobwebbed and empty. The air is thick enough to lean on. A young man sits on the edge of one with a candle stub in both hands, and he stands when he sees you.
second floor — social hall.name: Second Floor — Social Hall

second floor — sunken landing.description: A landing sunk a hand's depth into the floor, its stones soft with damp. The way east is clear if you step where the dust has already been broken.
second floor — sunken landing.name: Second Floor — Sunken Landing

second floor — trap hall.description: The floor is covered in dust, and the dust lies in a soft blanket — except where it dips, in a wide oval at the centre, too smooth to be natural. The edge stands in little ridges.
second floor — trap hall.name: Second Floor — Trap Hall

second floor — wax refill.description: Wax has pooled in the low places and set under years of settled dust — a grey, soft landscape of it. It is the first thing here that looks peaceful and means it.
second floor — wax refill.name: Second Floor — Wax Refill

seventh floor — connector 1.description: A narrow passage, the walls canted a few degrees off true. The candle reaches the first sconce and no further. Something has scratched the plaster at shoulder height, over and over.
seventh floor — connector 1.name: Seventh Floor — Connector 1

seventh floor — connector 2.description: A dead end. Dust has settled in a long drift against the wall, and a cold draught moves through it from somewhere that has no opening. The air smells of stone and old rain.
seventh floor — connector 2.name: Seventh Floor — Connector 2

seventh floor — connector 3.description: The corridor turns back on itself. You pass four sconces, then a fifth you would swear you have passed already. The flame leans as you walk, as if the air is following you.
seventh floor — connector 3.name: Seventh Floor — Connector 3

seventh floor — connector 4.description: A landing. A black ring is scorched into the boards, wax run and set and never scraped away. Someone's light ended here, and no one came back for the candle.
seventh floor — connector 4.name: Seventh Floor — Connector 4

seventh floor — connector 5.description: A cramped turn where the stone sweats. The ceiling is close enough to touch. Your flame hisses faintly and throws its light short; the walls drink it.
seventh floor — connector 5.name: Seventh Floor — Connector 5

seventh floor — connector 6.description: An alcove lined with empty iron sconces, every wick burned to a black stub. The metal is cold. It smells of soot and old iron, and nothing else.
seventh floor — connector 6.name: Seventh Floor — Connector 6

seventh floor — connector 7.description: A window-slit, its glass gone to teeth. Beyond it there is no sky and no ground — only a flat black that your breath does not fog. The draught comes off it steadily, inward.
seventh floor — connector 7.name: Seventh Floor — Connector 7

seventh floor — connector 8.description: A short stone bridge over a shaft. The candlelight goes down a few feet and stops. There is no rail. The air rising from below is cold and slow.
seventh floor — connector 8.name: Seventh Floor — Connector 8

seventh floor — grand stair.description: A marble descent, every step polished, every wall angled to flatter a single figure walking down. The stair is cold underfoot. At its head, an iron door.
seventh floor — grand stair.name: Seventh Floor — Grand Stair

seventh floor — spire.description: Cold stone, a low ceiling of dark, and walls hung with portraits of the same man. The clothes change; the face does not. Every painted eye is turned toward your candle, and they follow it a beat late, like a room pretending not to watch. The mirror above the sconce gives back the gallery and your face, and the wall behind you — where nothing stands.
seventh floor — spire.name: Seventh Floor — Spire

seventh floor — teaching nest.description: An aviary of empty cages, their gilded doors hanging open. Bats crowd the rafters, thin and restless, their small faces turning toward the flame. None of them scatter. One cage is newer than the rest; its bars are clean.
seventh floor — teaching nest.name: Seventh Floor — Teaching Nest

seventh floor — wax cache.description: A gilded niche worked into the wall, its filigree thick with old wax. Someone spent a great deal of light here to be seen doing it. A stub of wax sits in the dust at the bottom.
seventh floor — wax cache.name: Seventh Floor — Wax Cache

sixth floor — beast warren.description: Rats move in a brown tide, each dragging something bright — a coin, a ring, a candle stub carried like a trophy. They gnaw through coin and match alike. They are not afraid of the light.
sixth floor — beast warren.name: Sixth Floor — Beast Warren

sixth floor — collapsed landing.description: A landing half fallen in, its stones stepped down like a broken stair. The way east is clear if you watch your feet.
sixth floor — collapsed landing.name: Sixth Floor — Collapsed Landing

sixth floor — connector 1.description: A passage whose walls lean toward each other. The dark between the sconces is complete. Somewhere ahead, something drags and stops, as if it heard you stop too.
sixth floor — connector 1.name: Sixth Floor — Connector 1

sixth floor — connector 2.description: A landing with a dead lantern on a hook, its wick cold and black. The glass is smoked. A bundle of matches lies half under its base.
sixth floor — connector 2.name: Sixth Floor — Connector 2

sixth floor — connector 3.description: A corridor that doubles back. No sconce is lit. Two candles would make two circles here; one makes a single small room that moves with you.
sixth floor — connector 3.name: Sixth Floor — Connector 3

sixth floor — connector 4.description: A cramped turn. Low on the stone, at knee height, someone has scratched a warning with a nail: WE WENT ROUND. IT STILL TOOK HER. Beneath it, a row of small tally marks.
sixth floor — connector 4.name: Sixth Floor — Connector 4

sixth floor — connector 5.description: An alcove. A torn page lies flat on the stone where someone dropped it and did not come back for it. The dust around it is disturbed in one direction only — toward the page.
sixth floor — connector 5.name: Sixth Floor — Connector 5

sixth floor — dust passage.description: A service passage behind the trap hall, narrow and furred with dust. The walls are scratched at shoulder height, as if something counted its way along them.
sixth floor — dust passage.name: Sixth Floor — Dust Passage

sixth floor — entry landing.description: The stair arrives among strongboxes stacked to the ceiling, and coffins packed with dark earth. A hinge somewhere in the stacks eases open a finger's width, then holds. The candle does not reach the top of the room.
sixth floor — entry landing.name: Sixth Floor — Entry Landing

sixth floor — grand stair.description: A stair of dark wood, each tread inlaid with a coin that rings faintly underfoot. At the head, an iron door. The coins go quiet at the threshold, as if listening.
sixth floor — grand stair.name: Sixth Floor — Grand Stair

sixth floor — key room.description: A vault. Gold lies heaped in a shallow nest at the centre — coins, plate, a child's cup, rings like gravel. The key rests on top, plain iron. The heap shifts a finger's width when the air moves.
sixth floor — key room.name: Sixth Floor — Key Room

sixth floor — narrow turn.description: The passage pinches to a shoulder's width and turns. A cold draft comes from the far side, carrying the smell of old stone and dry paper.
sixth floor — narrow turn.name: Sixth Floor — Narrow Turn

sixth floor — social hall.description: A long table under a dead chandelier, ledgers stacked like masonry. A woman sits at the near end with her own candle, working a column. She does not look up until she has finished it.
sixth floor — social hall.name: Sixth Floor — Social Hall

sixth floor — trap hall.description: The floor is not a floor. Coins and plate are heaped over a sag in the boards, and where the heap meets the wall a hairline crack runs joint to joint. Dust sifts through it in a thin, steady trickle.
sixth floor — trap hall.name: Sixth Floor — Trap Hall

sixth floor — wax refill.description: A shrine-table crowded with votive cups, each pooled with wax gone dark and old. Some of it is still soft. The room smells of cold incense and tallow.
sixth floor — wax refill.name: Sixth Floor — Wax Refill

third floor — beast warren.description: Old straw, old troughs, and shades moving through the walls like smoke through a grate — thin, hungry, not quite shaped. They gather toward the light, and where they press close the flame leans and thins.
third floor — beast warren.name: Third Floor — Beast Warren

third floor — connector 1.description: A passage that smells of cold grease. A plate has been left on the floor against the wall, and the dust on it is undisturbed. The sconces are empty.
third floor — connector 1.name: Third Floor — Connector 1

third floor — connector 2.description: A landing of empty iron sconces, all cold. The floor is sticky in one place, as if something was spilled and never wiped.
third floor — connector 2.name: Third Floor — Connector 2

third floor — connector 3.description: A corridor that doubles back. There is no sconce lit. The air is warmer here than it should be, and it carries a smell of tallow.
third floor — connector 3.name: Third Floor — Connector 3

third floor — connector 4.description: A cramped turn, the stone slick with damp. The water catches the candlelight and gives it back doubled, so the corridor looks wider than it is.
third floor — connector 4.name: Third Floor — Connector 4

third floor — connector 5.description: A short bridge over a shaft. The candlelight goes down a few feet and stops. The air rising from below is warm, and it smells of the feast.
third floor — connector 5.name: Third Floor — Connector 5

third floor — entry landing.description: The stair arrives into the smell of a feast gone over — meat sweetening, wine souring, candles burned down into the bones of themselves. Long tables recede into the dark, every plate heaped, every chair pushed back.
third floor — entry landing.name: Third Floor — Entry Landing

third floor — grand stair.description: A stair so wide it could seat a banquet along it. The faint marks on the steps suggest it once did. At the head, an iron door.
third floor — grand stair.name: Third Floor — Grand Stair

third floor — key room.description: Hooks line the ceiling, and from them hang cuts of meat gone grey and dry. They do not smell like meat. The key hangs from a hook between them, iron and plain.
third floor — key room.name: Third Floor — Key Room

third floor — social hall.description: Long tables laid for a dinner that has lasted centuries — trenchers of dust, cups of something that used to be wine. At the far end, a small, careful man works the underside of a table with both hands.
third floor — social hall.name: Third Floor — Social Hall

third floor — trap hall.description: A long table stripped to bone-white wood. Beneath it the floor is a puzzle of boards that no longer lie flat. The centre boards gape, and something under them shifts when the air moves.
third floor — trap hall.name: Third Floor — Trap Hall

third floor — wax refill.description: A great copper vat, brimming with wax still warm. A scum of something darker floats on the top. The whole room smells of rendered fat and old feast.
third floor — wax refill.name: Third Floor — Wax Refill

fifth floor stair door.description: The iron door at the head of the stair down to the fourth floor. Locked.
fifth floor stair door.name: Fifth Floor Stair Door

fifth floor wax.description: Pooled wax under a sconce — the fifth floor's guaranteed refill.
fifth floor wax.name: Fifth Floor Wax

first floor key.description: The ground-floor iron key — the bow that opens the exit. The reliable way out, and the only one that is fully your own.
first floor key.name: First Floor Key

first floor wax.description: Pooled wax — the first floor's guaranteed refill.
first floor wax.name: First Floor Wax

fourth floor stair door.description: The iron door at the head of the stair down to the third floor. Locked.
fourth floor stair door.name: Fourth Floor Stair Door

fourth floor wax.description: Pooled, re-hardened wax — the fourth floor's guaranteed refill.
fourth floor wax.name: Fourth Floor Wax

matches (fourth).description: Two matches bound with waxed thread. A snuff is survivable only while one of these remains.
matches (fourth).name: Matches (Fourth)

matches (second).description: Two matches bound with waxed thread. A snuff is survivable only while one of these remains.
matches (second).name: Matches (Second)

matches (sixth).description: Two matches bound with waxed thread. A snuff is survivable only while one of these remains.
matches (sixth).name: Matches (Sixth)

page — the bitten.description: A torn page in an archivist's hand.
page — the bitten.name: Page — The Bitten
page — the bitten.read_text: "...she will not light her candle. Do not ask her to. She has already paid for the dark and does not wish to be reminded of the price."

page — the borrowed door.description: A torn page, scratched over with a warning.
page — the borrowed door.name: Page — The Borrowed Door
page — the borrowed door.read_text: "...if another reaches the door first, it may stand open a while. I do not know how long. I know that the one who slips out behind another does not sleep well after."

page — the count waits.description: A torn page, dropped where someone stopped to read it.
page — the count waits.name: Page — The Count Waits
page — the count waits.read_text: "...he does not follow. I have run from him for six days and he has not followed once. He is always at the edge of the lamp when I stop. It is the stopping he waits for."

page — the key.description: A torn page on a feasting table, under a plate no one has lifted in years.
page — the key.name: Page — The Key
page — the key.read_text: "...the key is always in the room that feels safest. That is the cruelty of it. The danger is the walking between."

page — the last muster.description: A torn page near the exit, held down by an old weapon.
page — the last muster.name: Page — The Last Muster
page — the last muster.read_text: "...they do not guard the door. They only wait to see whether the light or the fear gives out first."

page — the torpor.description: A torn page in the dust of a coffin room.
page — the torpor.name: Page — The Torpor
page — the torpor.read_text: "...the dust here is kind. That is the danger. It asks nothing of you but that you stop."

page — the weather.description: A torn page pinned behind a portrait whose eyes no longer follow it.
page — the weather.name: Page — The Weather
page — the weather.read_text: "...the sky is not the sky here. It answers the hand. I have seen it darken when I was cruel, and clear when I was kind, and I do not know which of us it was watching."

second floor stair door.description: The iron door at the head of the stair down to the first floor. Locked.
second floor stair door.name: Second Floor Stair Door

second floor wax.description: Pooled wax — the second floor's guaranteed refill.
second floor wax.name: Second Floor Wax

seventh floor key.description: A heavy iron key with a rope-ring bow, cold to the touch. It opens the stair down from the Spire.
seventh floor key.name: Seventh Floor Key

seventh floor stair door.description: The iron door at the head of the caged stair down. Locked; the seventh floor's key opens it.
seventh floor stair door.name: Seventh Floor Stair Door
seventh floor stair door.noise: A low groan of old hinges.

sixth floor stair door.description: The iron door at the head of the stair down to the fifth floor. Locked.
sixth floor stair door.name: Sixth Floor Stair Door

sixth floor wax.description: Pooled, re-hardened wax under a sconce — the sixth floor's guaranteed refill.
sixth floor wax.name: Sixth Floor Wax

the exit door.description: Heavy, iron-bound, and locked. The only way out. It does not open to the dark, and it does not open to another's passing — only to the key, and to your own light.
the exit door.name: The Exit Door

third floor stair door.description: The iron door at the head of the stair down to the second floor. Locked.
third floor stair door.name: Third Floor Stair Door

third floor wax.description: Pooled wax — the third floor's guaranteed refill.
third floor wax.name: Third Floor Wax

wax stub.description: A stub of candle-wax pressed into the stone. It will buy back a little light.
wax stub.name: Wax Stub

your candle.description: A candle in a brass dish. Its flame reaches a few feet and no further. The wax is already lower than it was when you woke.
your candle.name: Your Candle
